message: The other day, I was watching the weather report, and wouldn’t you know it, my phone decided it was the perfect time to die. I thought, great, just when I need to stay updated on the impending storm. Luckily, I had my trusty radio stashed away, which reminded me of the good old days. It’s funny how we rely so much on our gadgets, but sometimes, it’s the simple things that keep us connected. Just a little nudge to have a backup plan—like a good ol’ radio or some printed weather updates—just in case! 📻
